what: Pre-registration of the local-arm extension of the Phase 10 rerun (Phase 12, Task 4). Committed before any of its runs.

design.cells: each model x each condition (WITHOUT, WITH the ceiling fields)
design.run_numbers: 6-15 in each cell, beside runs 1-5 already on record
design.gpu: one model at a time: qwen2.5:7b, then qwen3.5:4b (the harness unloads any other resident model first)

unchanged_from_runs_1_5.switch: the prepared-payload switch (WITHOUT: the WITH model-visible payload minus the ceiling keys, handed over as prepared)
unchanged_from_runs_1_5.proof: proof_prepared_payload_2026-09-26.json, PROVEN 71 of 71, on the HEAD these runs use; run refuses to start without the newest proof passing
unchanged_from_runs_1_5.prompt: CASE_E in stage1_igv_assistant/benchmark/phase10_rerun.py -- a reconstruction, as recorded in every run file
unchanged_from_runs_1_5.config: num_ctx 32768, max_iters 40, untrimmed tool descriptions, think='low' where Ollama's /api/show declares the thinking capability (qwen3.5:4b), omitted otherwise (qwen2.5:7b)

seeds.order: each model's 20 new runs (10 WITHOUT, 10 WITH) are interleaved by random.Random(seed).shuffle with seed '20260925:<model>:start6'; the resulting order is written to meta_runs6-15.json
seeds.sampling: no Ollama sampling seed is sent, exactly as in runs 1-5, so each run samples with Ollama's default random seed; that seed is not exposed and is not recorded

replacements: as in the local arm: a run whose per-call ablation check did not hold, or that ended on a transport error (an Ollama request failure), is replaced once and the replacement is recorded beside it as <COND>__run<k>_replacement.json; an empty answer is a result and is not replaced

analysis_fixed_in_advance.scores: the blind scores of Phase 12 Task 5 (every item scored from the prompt and the final answer alone, on C1, C1b, C2 and C3 as written in scores.json), unblinded after scoring
analysis_fixed_in_advance.run_used_in_a_cell: a run's recorded replacement where it has one, otherwise the run itself
analysis_fixed_in_advance.test: Fisher's exact test, two-sided, WITH vs WITHOUT, per model, on the 15-run cells
analysis_fixed_in_advance.outcomes: C3 (completes the argument) and C2 (asserts the ceiling is unattainable) as the two tested outcomes; C1b reported descriptively
analysis_fixed_in_advance.no_other_tests: no further tests, subsets or pooling across models are added after the results are seen
